definitions.general: Non-GIS concepts reusable in the normal icon gallery, including UI, charts, drawing, maps/pins/navigation, people, places, objects, and industry subject symbols.
definitions.gis: Spatial analysis, geoprocessing, geographic data formats and services, GIS feature/layer workflows, remote sensing, surveying, georeferencing, and Esri/ArcGIS product identities.

boundary_notes: General means non-GIS; some healthcare, public-safety, engineering, and other subject symbols may later fit separate domain packs.
Simple maps, pins, compasses, routes, basic geometry, layer stacks, and generic knowledge graphs are general-purpose. GIS layer types and operations are GIS-specific.
General drawing/editing and image-processing primitives stay general even when Esri uses them in GIS. Georeferenced imagery and explicitly raster/geospatial workflows are GIS-specific.
Esri/ArcGIS product identities stay in GIS-specific. Other brand marks stay general.
Point-symbol names containing Esri, such as pin-esri, remain general when their meaning is a basic map marker rather than a product identity.
Original identifiers and existing variants are preserved. No size variants were added, and no entries were merged or removed.
This file uses the existing GIS/general classification without changing any assignments. Its icons array contains only the GIS group and matches gis-specific-icons.txt exactly, in the same order.

Original source metadata is retained. Shared metadata field names follow the healthcare-only inventory, including source, display_name, source_category, tags, gallery, classification_reason, and suggested_package.

A null representative_svg_url means the source inventory did not provide a standalone SVG URL. The recorded source_path, source_bundle_url, import_path, and reference_url are preserved when available.
